function_identities: public.aws_endorsement_email_event(text, text, timestamp with time zone, text)
order_note: No predecessor. SQL 170 adds what a payee's endorsement request needs to show whether its email was delivered, bounced or marked as spam and when the payee opened the link (owner 2026-11-19, "Is there anyway for tenants to see if an email has been delivered and opened? For this to show up near the payee signature request", then "Yeah build 1 and 2": the opened link and Resend's delivery reports; no tracking pixel). On public.check_endorsements: eight new columns, email_message_id text, email_delivered_at, email_bounced_at, email_bounce_reason text, email_complained_at, link_first_opened_at, link_last_opened_at (timestamptz, all nullable, no default) and link_open_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; the partial index check_endorsements_email_message_id_idx on (email_message_id) WHERE email_message_id IS NOT NULL; no column grant (the table SELECT for checksops already covers new columns). Three new SECURITY DEFINER functions (plpgsql, VOLATILE, search_path public, row_security off; EXECUTE checksops and the owner, revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role): aws_endorsement_email_sent(uuid, text), aws_endorsement_email_event(text, text, timestamp with time zone, text) and aws_endorsement_link_opened(uuid). The file refuses (55000) sql170_prerequisite_missing, sql170_definer_cannot_write (the applying login must own check_endorsements without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or be a superuser or BYPASSRLS; the engine's definer_can_write_relations) and sql170_column_conflict (a new column already present with another type, NOT NULL or default). No policy, trigger, table grant, other column or row change beyond link_open_count's default. Expected pre-state in both environments: everything absent (release sql170 v1: 747d10df6bd187e566fff75f14e2c2be43f14e350e70a7fabb8457931a3a7dc4, releaseStateHash('sql170', {})). The API that calls the functions and the website that shows the status are later, separate changes (a Lambda overlay and a website upload, after this pin is applied in production). No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
